# Jeju Dining

> Jeju Dining (제주 다이닝) is a free 3D restaurant time-management game that runs in the web browser. The player runs a small traditional Korean hanok diner: seat guests, take orders, let the chef cook, and serve each plate before the guest's patience runs out.

- Play: https://aswinidinergame.vercel.app/
- Platform: any modern web browser with WebGL; no download, no account
- Price: free
- Players: single player
- Languages: English interface, Korean names and signage
- Built with: Three.js and Vite; all 3D models, textures and music are generated procedurally in code
- Author: Aswini Balasubramanian
- Source: https://github.com/AswiniBalasubramanian/Aswinidiner

## How to play

1. Click an empty stool to seat a guest waiting at the entrance.
2. Click the seated guest to take their order; it goes to the kitchen as a ticket.
3. The chef cooks it at the stove and places the plate on the pass.
4. Click the plate, then the guest it belongs to. Fast service earns a tip.
5. A service lasts three minutes. Holding the wrong plate? Click the dustbin and the chef remakes it.

## Levels and daily targets

- Level 1 — The counter: ₩20,000
- Level 2 — The courtyard (string lights, garden table): ₩35,000
- Level 3 — The deck (timber deck under a vine pergola): ₩55,000
- Level 4 — The pyeongsang (raised wooden platform with cushions): ₩80,000
- Level 5 — Night market (red lanterns, third courtyard table): ₩110,000

Meeting the target unlocks the next level. Any reached level can be replayed from the level board.

## Menu

Bibimbap ₩9,000 · Ramyeon ₩6,000 · Kimbap ₩5,000 · Tteokbokki ₩7,000 · Bulgogi ₩12,000 (market unlock)

## Market upgrades

Courtyard table (+2 seats), twin-burner stove (30% faster cooking), warm lanterns (guests wait 25% longer), street signboard (more guests), Bulgogi on the menu.

## Other features

Day/night lighting toggle, procedurally generated lofi music, rename your diner, progress saved in the browser.
